triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Path: integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix

## Triage: priority:p2 · domain:server · pm:queue · 2026-11-02T05:07Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. `splitSecret` (packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts) treats `"secret": ""` as a value. An admin PATCH therefore rotates the working credential into an empty one, and the status reason then blames a missing row. The door is admin-only and no credential is disclosed, so this is not a SECURITY flag. It is a user-visible behaviour defect that breaks the datasource at the next reconnect, so it is p2 in `domain:server`, and it goes to `pm:queue`.
